Intel: chunk multi-function Rust source into pieces

```typescript title="WebAssembly"

function main() {
  const result = process("fn alpha() {}\n\nfn beta() {}\n\nfn gamma() {}\n\nfn delta() {}\n", { chunkMaxSize: 30, language: "rust" });
```
